SLOPPY JOE BUNS RECIPE BELOW Ingredients DOUGH 250 ml lukewarm milk (1 cup) 15 g honey (1 tbsp) 7 g instant yeast (1 tbsp) 1 large egg 45 g unsalted butter, room temperature (3 tbsp, 1/2 stick) 500 g all-purpose flour (4 cups) 8 g fine salt (1⅓ tsp) SLOPPY JOE FILLING 25 ml olive oil (2 tbsp) 600 g ground beef (1⅓ lb) 4 g fine salt (⅔ tsp) 3 g paprika (1 tsp) 2 g garlic powder (⅔ tsp) 3 g onion powder (1 tsp) 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 1.5 g black pepper (½ tsp) 100 g ketchup (6 tbsps) EXTRA cheese slices (American or cheddar) Big Mac-style burger sauce 1 egg, beaten Sesame seeds Instructions Prepare all the ingredients. In a large bowl, combine the lukewarm milk, honey and yeast. Stir well and let the mixture rest for 5 minutes. Add the egg and butter and mix well. Add the flour and salt. Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes until smooth. Cover the bowl and let the dough rise in a warm spot for 1 hour, or until doubled in size. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef, salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper and black pepper. Cook for 7-8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Add the ketchup. Stir the ketchup into the beef until well combined. Let the filling cool completely before adding it to the dough. Deflate the risen dough and divide it into 9 equal pieces. Shape each piece into a ball. Roll each dough ball into a round sheet. Place a slice of cheese in the center of each disc, then top with some of the beef filling and a spoonful of burger sauce. Add extra cheese if you like. Fold the dough inwards and pinch it tightly closed. Place the buns seam side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Let rise for 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 12-18 minutes, or until golden brown. #food #sloppyjoe #beef #cheese #tiktokfood

Crispy cheeseburger wraps Ingredients  For the beef mixture: 1 lb ground beef ( 80% lean, 20% fat ) 2 tbsp oil 1 yellow onion, finely diced  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced 1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 large jalapeño, chopped 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1/2 cup water For the cheese burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp yellow mustard 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  1 1/2 tbsp finely minced dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 1 tsp finely minced onion 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper To assemble: 9 medium tortilla wraps 1 1/2 cup Mexican style four cheese  1/2 cup caramelized onions 1/3 cup picked jalapeños, chopped  Oil for pan frying  Method: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and fully cooked. Drain excess fat if needed, leaving a little behind. Add tomato paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder. Cook 1–2 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce jalapeños and water. For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pickles, pickle juice, onion, garlic powder, smoked paprika, sugar and black pepper until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use. Lay out the tortillas and spread about 1 tbsp sauce slightly below the center. Add about 1/4 cup beef, 2 tbsp cheese, caramelized onions and pickled jalapeños. Fold the bottom over the filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place wraps seam-side down and cook 2–3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and crispy. Continue cooking until all sides are crisp and the cheese is melted. Crockpot Mongolian Beef & Noodles 🥩🍜🔥 Crockpot Series Episode 7: Mongolian Beef & Noodles This is my crockpot series, where I help you make easy recipes so good you might find a spouse or impress the one you’ve got. Tender chuck roast, a sweet and savory Mongolian-style sauce, and noodles coated in all that flavor. We sear the beef for extra color, then the crockpot does the work and you take the credit! 🙌🏽🔥 Ingredients: 2 pounds thinly sliced chuck roast 4 tablespoons butter, for searing 1 cup low-sodium shoyu 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup low-sodium beef broth 2 tablespoons minced garlic 1 tablespoon grated ginger 2 tablespoon sesame oil 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 1 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons cornstarch 2 tablespoons cold water 12 ounces precooked lo mein noodles. I used yakisoba noodles brand is Fortune. Sliced green onions Sesame seeds, optional Instructions: 1. Season your beef with SPG or your favorite seasoning. Heat a skillet over high heat with the butter and sear the beef in small batches for 1-2 minutes per side. You’re building color, not cooking it through. 2. Transfer the beef to the crockpot. Deglaze the skillet with a splash of the measured beef broth, scrape up those browned bits, and pour everything into the crockpot. 3. Add the remaining broth, shoyu, brown sugar, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and black pepper. Stir gently. 4. Cover and cook on LOW for 4 to 5 hours or HIGH for 2.5 to 3.5 hours. Start checking early so the thin beef stays tender without falling apart. 5. Mix the cornstarch slurry with a cup of broth. Stir the slurry into the sauce and cook on HIGH for 15–20 minutes, until thick and glossy. 6. Slice the green onions into 1 inch piece. Separate the precooked noodles and add them directly to the crockpot. Toss everything together and heat on HIGH for 5–10 minutes. 7. Finish with sliced green onions, sesame seeds, and chili crisp oil if you want some heat then serve immediately. Don’t leave those noodles sitting on KEEP WARM—they’ll keep drinking up the sauce. Save this one for an easy weeknight dinner! 🍜🔥 #crockpotrecipes #crockpot #EasyRecipe #hawaiitiktok #mongolianbeef

MARRY ME MASH 🥔✨ Recipe below ⬇️ This is the ultimate recipe for luxurious mashed potato. Ultra-smooth, buttery, garlic-thyme infused, finished with white pepper and nutmeg. Make no mistake - this is pure indulgence, and it will make your guests so silent at the table. Marry Me Mash: Peel and cube 1kg Maris Piper potatoes. Add to cold salted water, bring to the boil, then simmer gently until completely tender. Drain and leave to steam dry for 20-30 minutes (this step is key for texture). Meanwhile, gently simmer 200ml whole milk and 200ml double cream with 4 chopped garlic cloves and 3-4 thyme sprigs for 30 minutes to infuse. Strain and keep warm. Pass the dried potatoes through a ricer, then fold through 150g melted butter. For extra smoothness, push through a fine mesh sieve. Add the warm infused cream one ladle at a time until silky and smooth but still holding its shape. Season with fine salt, white pepper and a small grating of nutmeg. Taste and adjust. Bonus recipe - Braised Short Rib (perfect with this mash): Season 3-4 large beef short ribs generously with salt and pepper and sear in a hot casserole pot with 1 tbsp oil until deeply browned. Remove. In the same pot soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 diced carrots. Add 2 tbsp tomato purée, 3 sliced garlic cloves, 3 thyme sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Deglaze with 500ml red wine, reduce slightly, then add enough beef stock (around 750ml-1L) to fully submerge the ribs. Return the ribs, cover and cook at 130°C for 4 hours until spoon tender. Remove the ribs, strain and remove the fat from the sauce (use a separator jug if you have one). Pass through a fine sieve and then reduce it until glossy and thick enough to coat the back of a spoon. Return the ribs to the sauce and baste. Silky mash. Sticky, rich beef. Absolute comfort food - elevated. #mash #shortrib #cooking #recipe #food

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce. #recipe #garlicparmesan #chickenrolls

MEATBALL SUB BITES! Homemade meatballs tossed in pizza sauce, then wrapped up in pizza dough with mozzarella and baked until golden brown, then brushed with butter, parm & parsley. And warm pizza sauce for dipping. It’s game day season and these are the perfect 2-bite app that we’re 100% sure everyone will love!!  Full recipe at: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/meatball-sub-bites/ 1 lb 80/20 ground beef ½ cup Italian-seasoned breadcrumbs ½ cup whole milk 1 large egg ⅓ cup grated parmesan cheese 2 garlic cloves grated ¾ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon black pepper 8 ounces pizza dough 12 ounces pizza sauce divided ½ cup low-moisture mozzarella shredded 2 tablespoons melted butter for brushing Grated parmesan for topping Chopped parsley for topping Preheat your oven to 425˚F. To a small mixing bowl, add the breadcrumbs and milk together, stir, and let the mixture rest for five minutes. It should look like thick oatmeal, so add milk a tablespoon at a time if it looks dry. To a large mixing bowl, add the ground beef, panade, egg, parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper. Mix gently by hand just until combined. Using a 3 tablespoon scoop, scoop into 14 meatballs and roll them into shape. Bake the meatballs 425°F for about 15 minutes. Slightly underbaked is fine; they'll be going back into the oven later. Toss the meatballs in about 4 ounces of the pizza sauce, setting the other half of the sauce aside for dipping later. They should be coated, not drenched. Cut the dough. Roll to ~12×10" and cut into squares. Grease a muffin tin. To make one of the meatball sub bites, add a square of pizza dough into one of the muffin slots, then place a pinch of shredded mozzarella on the bottom, a saucy meatball on top, and a pinch more mozzarella over it. Gather the corners over the top of the meatball, one at a time. Bake at 400°F for about 18-20 minutes, until deep golden and 160°F+ in the center. Brush with butter and parmesan before serving.

Place over steam (on a saucepan with simmering water) and whisk 10 minutes on low heat until the mixture is pale, slightly thickened, and not grainy when you rub between your fingers. Remove from heat and whisk for a few minutes off the heat to help it cool down. Then set it aside to cool until the time to add it to the mascarpone. • In a separate bowl, beat together 16 oz mascarpone and 3 Tbsp 👑. Use an electric hand mixer to beat in the warm yolk mixture until well incorporated. • In a separate bowl, beat cold heavy whipping cream until stiff peaks form. Use a spatula to gently fold half of the whipped cream into mascarpone cream, then blend in the remaining whipped cream, just until incorporated. Do not overfold, or it will become grainy. Soak the Ladyfingers: • In a wide bowl, mix 1 1/2 cups espresso and 3 Tbsp of 👑. Quickly dip half of the ladyfingers, one at a time, and then arrange them in a single layer in the bottom of a 9×13 dish. Dip once on each side so they are moist, but do not soak ladyfingers or the cake will collapse. Only 2 seconds submerged in the liquid max. Layer the Tiramisu: • Spread half of the cream over the first layer of ladyfingers. Dip and arrange the remaining ladyfingers on top, and then spread the remaining cream on top. Cover with foil and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. Cheese stuffed Garlic Naan Ingredients For the dough: • 3 1/2 cups all-purpose flour • 1 1/2 cups warm water • 1 teaspoon yeast • 1 teaspoon salt • 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil •. 1 cup mozzarella shredded cheese For the garlic topping: • ¼ cup olive oil • 3 cloves garlic, smashed • ⅛ cup chopped parsley or cilantro ⸻ Instructions 1. Activate the yeast: In a large bowl, combine warm water and yeast. Let it sit for about 5 minutes until the yeast starts to foam. 2. Make the dough: Add flour and salt to the yeast mixture. Mix with a spoon at first, then knead by hand or with a mixer for about 5 minutes until a soft dough forms. 3. Add the oil: Rub your hands with olive oil and knead the dough a few more times until smooth. 4. First rise: Cover the dough with a warm towel and let it rest in a warm place for about 1 hour, or until doubled in size. 5. Shape the naan: Once risen, divide the dough into balls. Flatten them out add some of the mozzarella cheese in the middle close it up into a ball. Place them in a warm area again, covered, and let them rise for another 30 minutes. 6. Cook the naan: Heat a grill pan or regular pan over medium heat. Lightly oil the surface. Flatten each dough ball with your hands or a rolling pin. Cook each naan for 1–2 minutes per side, or until golden brown spots appear. 7. Make the garlic oil: In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, smashed garlic, and chopped parsley or cilantro. 8. Finish: Brush the hot naan with the garlic oil and enjoy immediately! #bread #fyp #fypシ #Recipe #EasyRecipe

Meal Prep w/me -Chipotle Honey Chicken🍯🌶️ This spicy +sweet Chipotle inspired chicken had me in a chokehold all summer, and I wanted to share it w/you..🥰 Ingredients 2 lbs chicken thighs  2 small cans of Chipotle Adobo Sauce 1 tbsp cumin 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt 1 tbsp garlic powder 1/2 tbsp black pepper 2 tbsp lime juice 2 tbsp lemon juice 3 tbsp honey Directions: -RICE PREP: add 1 cup washed jasmine rice to either the stovetop or a rice cooker. Add 2 cups of water and drizzle of olive oil. If using rice cooker, set timer to preset cook option. If using a stovetop, bring the water to a boil then reduce heat to low, cover, and cook until rice is tender and water is fully absorbed.  -CHICKEN PREP: Add cumin, smoked paprika, salt, garlic powder, black pepper and 1 can of Adobo sauce to chicken thighs that have been washed, dried, and trimmed from fat. Mix thoroughly. -Add small amount of olive oil to a pan and cook chicken on medium heat for 2-3 minutes per side, or until outside of chicken is caramelized brown and inside is fully cooked.  -Cut chicken into cubes and drizzle honey adobo sauce (3 tbsp honey + 1 small can adobo sauce) over it. Mix thoroughly -CILANTRO RICE: Add a drizzle of oil to the fully cooked rice, then mix in 1/4-1/3 cup fresh chopped cilantro, then add a pinch of salt + lemon +lime juice. Serve chicken over the cilantro rice. Takes 30 minutes. Enjoy! #mealprepping #fatlosscoach
